highest_leverage_targets.reason: The 27 July 2022 LAJ receipt proves a quarterly-report filing as 5367/2022, but the recovered notification package does not contain the underlying report. Later primary reports identify the 15th report as the operative description of completed asset liquidation. Recovering the 5367/2022 source and the 15th report can narrow both AC-REPORT-SERIES and FINAL-STAGE; no identity or ordinal is inferred without primary proof.
Primary late reports indicate liquidation completion and no pending credits against the estate, making the remaining post-liquidation chain a finite set of identifiable nodes.

public_wording: Nine P0 evidence families remain open. Primary-source recovery has materially narrowed several of them: the October 2021 chain, the AC-report series and the 2022-2023 review family now contain located primary nodes, while current appeals have located procedural nodes but no merits endpoint yet located. Within the AC-report series, the 27 July 2022 LAJ receipt for filing 5367/2022 is located, but the underlying quarterly report has not yet been located in the controlled corpus. No family is treated as closed until its pre-existing closure test is satisfied.
privacy_rule: Do not publish private mailbox identifiers, contact data, counsel advice or derivative allegations as evidence. Promote primary court, LAJ or AC instruments only after source verification, privacy review and canonical hashing.
